unsupported: This kit version is not supported. Open the source and use data-alpha-kit="1".
invalidTable: Table enhancement is unavailable. Use a rectangular table with one header row and at most 1,000 rows and 20 columns.
invalidChart: Chart enhancement is unavailable. Check the data table: up to 120 rows, three series, one shared unit, and finite numeric values; leave missing values empty.
invalidTabs: Tabs are unavailable. Give each section a unique ID and a tab label.
inspect: Chart values are available in the data table. Focus a plotted value to inspect it.
